canonical: When the owner column is absent, a ClientCore import assigns the importing user. An explicitly supplied unknown owner email fails with CC_IMPORT_017.
A withdrawn application is terminal and cannot be reopened by an employer.
Imported activities are deduplicated by tenant ID and source event ID, not timestamp alone.
Duplicate interview reminders were caused by retryNotification omitting the gateway idempotency key, not by queue visibility timeout.
The relevant TalentFlow retry symbol is retryNotification in src/notifications/retry.ts.
TalentFlow notification jobs use a 90-second visibility timeout.
Candidate resume download URLs expire after five minutes.
Archived ClientCore accounts are excluded from default search, while their activities remain available for audit.
Suspending a TalentFlow employer blocks new job posts but does not hide existing public listings.
CC_IMPORT_017 means an explicitly supplied owner email does not match an active ClientCore user.
Enterprise compensation analytics is an unreleased restricted proposal.
The fixture contains no approved or implemented automatic contact-merge behavior.
Account is project-scoped: a customer company in ClientCore and an employer login/tenant relationship in TalentFlow.
